resolved_findings: Capture actual tool receipt metadata before reporting gates or turn cleanup.
Ignore stale or duplicate completion events without canceling newer batches.
Cancel the batch on recognized chat stop/cancel, including visible approvals.
Only live in-memory batches trigger dispatch from tab selection; cold parallel history is not retried by the new hook.
Wait for the source terminal acknowledgment before serial/parent handoff dispatch; attribute failures to the originating generation before reflush or generation rejection.
Retain true transport completion separately from reporting failure and prevent dependent children or parent model from running after a blocked gate.
Blocked dispatch waits for a running child completion to construct the single final local notice.

Explicit work-order retry refuses while a terminal receipt process is in flight, preserving the original live batch and its source generation; automatic initial spawn still registers and awaits that source acknowledgment.
checks: Source-bound pending completions are removed before a single deferred completion is queued.
The reporting blocker matches parent/child recorded generations rather than the currently visible workspace.
Blocked parent notices remain paused, and stale/cold ownership cannot release them.
